info.name: Visa RAG Service
info.description:
Bangladesh passport -> India visa RAG service. Covers the RAG query/ingestion API, the applicant-profile API (Phase B), and the passport document-intelligence diagnostic endpoint (Phase C). See docs/api.md for full request/response shapes and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for design notes.

Run order for a fresh environment: Ingestion > Ingest Document, then Visa Query > Ask a Question. Applicant Profile and Applicant Document requests are independent of those and of each other, and share {{applicantId}} generated once by the collection pre-request script below.

request.description: Ask a visa question. visaType is optional; omit or set null to search across all visa types. A low-confidence match returns the fixed "I couldn't find sufficient official information." fallback rather than a fabricated answer.
path is resolved against knowledge-base.root (see application.properties) and must already exist under knowledge-base/. metadata.sourceUrl and metadata.version are optional.
Documents whose live source content has been detected as CHANGED by the scheduled SourceChangeMonitor job and is awaiting manual re-ingestion review.

A field set this way is self-declared and starts already USER_CONFIRMED. fieldPath must be one of ApplicantProfile's PATH_* constants (see docs/api.md for the full list); value is a plain string/number, or a nested address object for addressInfo.permanentAddress / addressInfo.currentAddress.
Example of the nested address-object shape required for addressInfo.permanentAddress / addressInfo.currentAddress.

Returns every field set so far for this applicantId, grouped into personalInfo/passportInfo/nationalityInfo/addressInfo/familyInfo/employmentInfo/travelInfo. applicantId is an opaque, unauthenticated UUID in Phase B - any UUID works, nothing needs to be created first.
action is CONFIRM, CORRECT, or REJECT. CORRECT requires correctedValue in the body (same shape as SetField's value); CONFIRM/REJECT ignore it.

formdata.description: A real passport bio-data page image (JPEG/PNG), cropped to just that page. Under 15MB.

request.description: The real upload-to-candidates flow: stores the image, runs the pre-OCR quality gate, then reads fields from MRZ (Tesseract OCR, checksum-validated) and vision (llava:7b under ollama / gpt-4o-mini under openai), cross-validating where both sources supply a field. Requires TESSDATA_PATH env var pointing at a real tessdata directory (see application.properties). Response mirrors DocumentExtractionResult: status is QUALITY_REJECTED (image too degraded, or no MRZ found - message explains why) or EXTRACTED (fieldCandidates keyed by ApplicantProfile.PATH_* constants, or path + '.conflict.mrz' / '.conflict.visual' where MRZ and vision disagreed - see docs/api.md).

formdata.description: A real passport bio-data page image (JPEG/PNG). Under 15MB (spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size).

request.description: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - not the production upload flow. Calls VisionExtractionPort directly (llava:7b under the ollama profile, gpt-4o-mini under openai), bypassing the image-quality gate, OCR, MRZ parsing, and persistence entirely - nothing here is stored or associated with applicantId. The real upload flow (DocumentIntelligenceService) has no controller yet and needs Tesseract OCR configured first. Click the file field's value and choose a real image before sending. Response mirrors VisualPassportData: passportNumber/dateOfBirth/expiryDate/issueDate/placeOfBirth/passportType, each { value, present, clearlyReadable }. Per-field accuracy varies between runs - see PROGRESS.md's 2026-09-02 entry.
